notes.title: Colossus Part 1 Update: Map 1 Rework, New Mutations System, and More!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=7cKuWMliLWo;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][h3]New Content[/h3][/u][b]MAP 1 REWORK:[/b]
- Reworked first 3 boss fights
- 10 new Miniboss enemies
- 2 new boss fights
- 3 new basic enemies

[b]- New Mutations System![/b] Unlock new permanent upgrades that can be selected during runs after boss kills!
[b]- New Callisto Current Upgrade Tree![/b]

[u][h3]Perk Changes[/h3][/u]- Blood Lust Upgrade now doesn’t factor in damage dealt by Combination Strike Weapon Perk
- Pulse Slash Weapon Perk’s Damage Multiplier to bosses changed from +100% -> +50%
- Fire Rate Nerfs added to certain Doom Rounds and Charged Rounds upgrades
- Shield Barrier Nerf, reworked to recharge based off of time passed rather than kills
- Charge Upgrade reworked: Temporarily increase Movement Speed by up to 50% over a course of 3 seconds until your next shot. Movement Speed +20%
- Magnetism Upgrade reworked: EXP Pickup Range +40%, Circle/Cone Vision Size +10%, Movement Speed -10%
- Slug Deflection can now trigger only up to 5 times

[u][h3]Visual Changes[/h3][/u]- New Upgrade Icon Art for Shield Barrier, Shrapnel, Cloned Sentry, Wind Up Strike, Wild Fire, Light Meteor, Psych Trail, Light Target, and Proximity Marker
- Added a particle for when Outflow upgrade is triggered
- Added a particle for Blood Geyser Weapon Perk
- Slight edits to Singularity appearance to increase general visibility
- Small changes to scorpion and cockroach appearance
- Railgun projectile color changed to blue to contrast new enemy attacks
- Temporarily changed Ricochet Rounds and Guided Laser icon art to placeholders
- Added details to player appearance
- Added a red screen indicator for taking damage
- Tweaks to contrast and saturation for several upgrade icons

[u][h3]Bug Fixes/Other[/h3][/u]- Fixed a visual bug where status particle effects would display incorrectly when an enemy is killed with multiple at once
- Fixed bug where score wouldn’t track properly when hud is disabled
- Fixed a memory leak issue while using certain melee weapons with Ricochet upgrade
- Changed movement settings to reduce amount of slide
- Added a maximum damage cap of 999999 (Prevents infinite health for late-game bosses which factor in DPS to scale)
- Added an option to adjust bullet opacity
- Adjusted Cone Vision rotation to smooth out jittery movement
- New songs added to Map 1

[h3]Thank you everyone for waiting a bit longer for this update! Colossus Part 2 Update is work in progress, which will rework Map 2 with new bosses, minibosses, enemies, and more![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661166/4223f0666eb3082708719356d2ce8c65a3ca4ce2.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 20: New Akimbo SMGs, 2 New Upgrades, Optimizations, and More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661166/7933af2e35763dae670fb41cdfbf02d16c89967d.png[/img]
[h3][u]New Content:[/u][/h3]
- New Weapon: [b]Akimbo SMGs[/b]
- New Upgrade Trees: [b]Noxious Trail, Light Meteor[/b] ([b]Light Target[/b] upgrades moved to this tree)

[h3][u]Changes to Existing Content:[/u][/h3]
- Reworked bottom upgrade tree of [b]Concealed Fatigue[/b] to a new [b]Shrouded Spiral[/b] upgrade
- Reworked some [b]Singularity[/b] upgrades and visuals, and fixed a bug where Singularities would still absorb bullets after being disabled
- [b]New Map 1 Soundtrack with reworked songs and a few new ones![/b]

[u]Buffs:[/u]
[b]Shrapnel[/b]: Bullet Damage +10% but Fire Rate -5%
[b]Burn[/b]: Enemies on Fire will now move 20% slower
[b]Firestarter[/b]: Enemies on Fire now take 30% more damage from all sources.
Moved [b]Dual Spotlight[/b] functionality to [b]Precision Light[/b]: Gain a 2nd smaller Vision Cone behind you.
Dual Spotlight changed to [b]Three-fold Light[/b]: Gain another Vision Cone for a total of 3.
[b]Ignition[/b]: Fire Rate is temporarily increased by 5% for each enemy damaged by a Wild Fire explosion (Stacks up to +30%). Lasts 4 seconds.
[b]Wild Fire Refresh[/b]: Enemies killed by Wild Fire will float their EXP toward you.
[b]Plasma Charge[/b]: Plasma Damage now slows enemies by 15%.
[b]Destructive Plasma[/b]: Upgrades that increase Bullet Damage now also apply to Plasma Damage.
[b]Explosive Plasma[/b]: Plasma Charges are now automatically fired when they're ready.
[b]Plasma Chain[/b]: On despawn, Plasma Charges now create temporary Vision Circles.
[b]Plasma Coil[/b]: Now deals damage based on Plasma Damage instead of Bullet Damage.
[b]Absorption Coil[/b]: Plasma Damage now slows enemies by 25%.
[b]Plasma Beam[/b]: Now briefly lights up area of effect.
Moved [b]Singularity Explosion[/b] functionality to [b]Singularity Absorption[/b]: On despawn, fire a burst of absorbed bullets towards where you're aiming (Max of 100 bullets).
Singularity Explosion changed to [b]Singularity Void[/b]: When a Singularity absorbs a projectile, fire a Ray towards a random enemy dealing 20 damage.
[b]Remote Detonation[/b]: Enemies killed by a Missile will float their EXP toward you. Missile Explosions are twice as large.
[b]Sprint[/b]: Movement Speed +5% -> +20%
[b]Lucky Bullet[/b]: Bullet Damage +30%
[b]Light Rounds[/b]: Movement Speed +20%

[u]Nerfs:[/u]
[b]Crippling Laser[/b] - Slow Rate: 80% -> 50%
[b]Laser Trio[/b]: 3 Guided Lasers can be active at a time, but they deal damage every 0.5 seconds. Fire Rate - 5%
[b]Ricochet Hell[/b] now takes a second to recharge after being triggered


[h3][u]Optimization/Bug Fixes/Other:[/u][/h3]
- Edited several upgrade sounds
- Updated enemy projectiles to increase their visibility
- Added an option to change the damage color for enemies
- Can now still delete upgrades when there are under 5 existing upgrades left
- Added a shadow to increase player visibility and a circular indicator that shows current EXP (Both can be toggled in settings)
- Fixed a memory issue with certain enemies not being disposed of properly after dying
- Reworked Wild Fire explosion visuals and sounds
- Optimized an issue with Phosphorus Missiles, which now also fires 10 trails instead of 9
- Adjusted models/stances for pistol, handcannon, and twin katanas 
- Railgun particles now appear below enemies and enemy projectiles for increased visibility
- Missiles will explode if not making contact with an enemy after 30 seconds
- Added a cap of 5 additional projectiles to Sight Confidence perk
- Exit Wound can now only stack up to 3 times to prevent infinite loops, and any bullets created by the perk will keep the same the speed as the original projectile
- Made Charged Rounds slightly brighter and added gold, blue, and magenta damage text colors for the corresponding type
- Added a slight fading to blaze particles
- Added a cap of how many objects can exist to prevent infinite loops for several upgrades
- Fixed bug where Pierce Recharge worked on some bosses
- Fixed bug where level up invulnerability wasn’t being applied on levels 10, 20, 30
- Fixed bug where hovering over upgrade icons sometimes didn’t display the correct information
- Fixed bug where upgrade name tooltip would still be visible while not hovering over any upgrade icon
- Fixed bug where Singularity Absorption wouldn’t work properly
- Added some slight shadows to certain hud elements
- Tweaked plasma charge visuals

notes.title: Here's a free shooter for fans of Vampire Survivors and Brotato
notes.content: We're all into this whole "reverse bullet hell" or "bullet heaven" genre these days, ever since Vampire Survivors kicked the arcade-style gameplay of this genre back into full gear and into the public eye. A recent free game called Disfigure has released for free on Steam, and it's yet more of that thing you probably quite like by now. The twist here? It's dark, and you've got to figure out your own strategy for dealing with a limited cone or circle of vision when enemies are coming from every side... Read more.

notes.title: Plans for the Future
notes.content:
Before launch, I never expected that this many players would have enjoyed Disfigure. Thank you to everyone who has tried it out and especially to those that have donated! Development will slow down for a while, as I will be leaving on a trip for 2 weeks and won't be able to update the game again until at least August 21st.

I'm using this announcement to let everyone know my plans going forward for the next few months.
My utmost priorities right now are improving the performance and fixing the crashing issues with the game, then replacing the AI icons in the game with simpler artwork to rid of ethical concerns regarding AI use. 

I will then just add more content to the game through additional weapons, upgrades, and difficulties (new enemies and boss fights). I'm always looking through the discussions on Steam and in the Community Discord, so make a post if you have an idea for new content! I also plan to add new tracks to the soundtrack. 

After I'm satisfied with the state of the game (Hoping to get the game to this state by late 2023/early 2024), I might decide to make the game paid for around $3-5 along with a large update (Disfigure 2.0) with game-changing amounts of new content. So grab the game now if you want to play it for free!

notes.content: Fixed a bug where upgrades that decreased max health didn't have an effect after picking up heart drops from bosses.

notes.title: Update 4: Controller Accessibility and Bug Fixes
notes.content: Can now select upgrades with the directional pad on controller. Fixed a bug where the Purchase Weapon button didn't show the cost of weapons.

notes.content: Fixed a bug where you could deal no damage when taking upgrades that decrease bullet damage.

notes.title: Update 2: Weapon Unlock Bug Fix and More Resolution Settings
notes.content: Fixed a bug where you could click the Purchase Weapon button and unlock nothing, also added 3440x1440 and 2560x1080 resolution settings.

notes.title: Update 1: Color Settings for Player and Crosshair
notes.content:
Some players have asked for the ability to customize the color of the player and the crosshair, so you can now do so in the Settings menu as well as in-game. 

I also want to thank you all for playing my game, especially those that have donated!

notes.title: Disfigure releasing on July 28th, 2023 for FREE!
notes.content:
I'm a solo developer currently making games as a hobby and I want as many people as possible to enjoy my games, so [i]Disfigure[/i] will be playable completely for free on July 28th! 

Donations can also be made to support the development of my game projects by purchasing the "DISFIGURE - DONATION" DLC which will be available at launch, though you can still play all of the game's content without doing so!

At launch, content will include:
[list]
[*] Over 100 upgrades
[*] 10 unique weapons each with 9 perks that can be chosen at level 10, 20, and 30
[*] 2 difficulty modes
[*] 9 enemy types
[*] 3 boss fights
[*] Online leaderboards
[/list]

notes.title: Future Steps: Thanks to everyone who played the demo!
notes.content: Thanks to everyone who played the demo! The full game will likely release around December to February, though I'll announce a release date at least a month in advance. For the game itself, I plan to add three times more enemies and bosses and overhaul the progression system to be more rogue-like with upgrades. I'm going to pause updating the demo for now while I implement the new content, but I will keep the demo up for those who wish to continue playing it!

notes.title: First Small Update: Thanks to all who played the demo!
notes.content:
Enemies will now bleed ammo if you damage them, leave them alive longer to get ammo and level up faster!

Thanks again to everyone who has played the demo, please leave any feedback in the community hub!

notes.title: Disfigure Demo Gameplay
notes.content:
Disfigure is a top-down shooter in which you fight in an arena full of increasingly grotesque creatures. Both ammo and vision are limited resources, use both efficiently to survive as long as possible.

This stream showcases all demo content, including the first three enemies, the first boss, and the first three weapons.
